Setup Instructions
fields.options:
Company Global Filter Settings

Configure how company filtering is applied across your ERPNext instance.

Key Settings:
  • Enable Company Filtering: Master switch to enable/disable filtering globally
  • Auto Create Fields: Automatically add custom_company fields to shared master doctypes
  • Field Placement: Choose where to place company fields in forms
  • Excluded DocTypes: List doctypes that should never be filtered
  • Excluded Roles/Users: Users with these roles or specific users can bypass filtering
  • Excluded Companies: Companies whose documents are visible to specific users/roles, bypassing company filter
  • Per-DocType Excluded Companies: Override global excluded companies for specific doctypes
How It Works:
  1. When enabled, all doctypes with a 'company' or 'custom_company' field are automatically filtered
  2. Users only see documents belonging to their selected/default company
  3. Documents from excluded companies are visible to users/roles specified in the excluded companies configuration
  4. Per-doctype excluded companies override global excluded companies for specific doctypes
  5. Filtering applies to list views, searches, and document access
  6. System doctypes and excluded doctypes are never filtered
Excluded Companies:
  • Global Excluded Companies: Apply to all doctypes. Documents from these companies are visible to specified users/roles.
  • Per-DocType Excluded Companies: Apply only to specific doctypes. Override global exclusions for that doctype.
  • Visibility Control: For each excluded company, specify which users or roles can see documents from that company.
  • Use Cases: Shared/global companies, master data companies, or companies that need cross-company visibility.

Note: Changes to these settings may require clearing cache or restarting the server.
